title: A form with validation
hints: Each input needs value={...} and onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}. Wrap the input in its <label>.
Put the handler on the form: <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>, and call event.preventDefault() first.
Keep a third piece of state, submitted, and show an error only when submitted is true and the field is invalid.
After a successful submit, set the fields back to "" and submitted back to false.
